question: What exact pickup bus and within-snapshot occurrence metadata does the unchanged production selector already know, independently of destination availability?
scope: Research-only contract and census; no source changes, model fitting, tracking replay, numerical/ranking/selection modification or new holdout. Reuse all 4688 existing historical decisions and both wire occurrences.
experiments: Extract exact current production live options block, retain current pickupState argument and assert all 4688 outputs/rankings against previously reviewed ordered decisions.
Instrument actual pickLiveArrival and raw-at-stop branches; classify same visit, different bus, same bus later visit, raw-at-stop with or without modeled current pickup, unavailable and departed.
Apply a fixed missing-destination ablation to all input wires; report selector/identity changes and compare pickup attribution independently of destination rather than claiming observed outcomes.

Boundary fixtures: same bus later visit, different bus without destination, absent/folded destination, stale data, raw-at-stop with only next-lap row, normalization, and current snapshot identity changes.
contractConstraints: Use existing selected rows; no second selector.
Forecast stopsAhead is relative to current snapshot and not a persistent physical visit ID.
Raw current observation without matching modeled pickup stays unlinked; never relabel next-lap row as current.
No boardable claim when departed/stale/future; no calibrated catch guarantee.
No UI code changes until cross-team review.
